title: guettarda granulata
intro: Guettarda granulata, commonly known as the "Hawaiian Roseapple" or "Rose Apple Tree", is a flowering plant species native to Hawaii. The Guettarda granulata plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. Its therapeutic actions include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating skin conditions and infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
